message.content:
I don’t have real‑time access to live exchange‑rate data, so I can only give you an approximate figure based on recent market levels.

As of the last few days, the USD/GBP rate has been hovering around **1 USD ≈ 0.78 GBP** (though it can fluctuate by a few pips). Using that rough estimate:

\[
\$20 \times 0.78 \approx £15.60
\]

So, roughly **£15.50–£15.70** would be the equivalent of $20 today. For an exact, up‑to‑minute conversion, you’d want to check a reliable financial source or a currency‑conversion API.
